artist.name: BULLZEYE
artist.bio: Bullzeye is an Indian DJ. His mixes have run on Furthur, Boshed in Goa, Minitech Recordings Radio and the Raipur Underground Community podcast, and he recorded a set at Der Weisse Hase in Berlin in July 2023.
